sentences.en: Love can't be encapsulated in words. It can only be felt.
sentences.zh: 爱无法用言语来概括，只能去感受。

sentences.en: No artist encapsulates this style than Yanni.
sentences.zh: 没有哪位艺术家能比扬尼更好地体现这种风格。

sentences.en: The company encapsulated the essence of their product into a short video.
sentences.zh: 这家公司把产品的精华浓缩在了一个短片里。
